[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 1: Behavior Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]1.1[/color] Be respectful to others OOC. ★
[color=#a4885c]1.2[/color] Do not use hate speech, racism, or other bigoted remarks. ★
[color=#a4885c]1.3[/color] Do not metagame. ★
[color=#a4885c]1.4[/color] Do not spam or advertise. ★
[color=#a4885c]1.5[/color] Do not intentionally take actions that negatively impact or disrupt others' enjoyment of the game. ★
[color=#a4885c]1.6[/color] Avoid discussing controversial topics such as self-harm or rape in public. ★★
[color=#a4885c]1.7[/color] Do not evade bans. ★★
[color=#a4885c]1.8[/color] Do not intentionally create unnecessary conflict or disruption without reasonable in-character justification. ★★
[color=#a4885c]1.9[/color] Do not cryo or disconnect to avoid in-character consequences. ★
[color=#a4885c]1.10[/color] Cheating and exploiting bugs are forbidden. ★★★
[color=#a4885c]1.11[/color] Respect others' OOC consent and preferences. ★★★
[color=#a4885c]1.11[/color] Suicide RP is prohibited. Many players may be dealing with personal struggles, and the game should remain a comfortable environment for everyone. Therefore, portraying suicide is not allowed, regardless of roleplay context. ★★
[color=#a4885c]1.12[/color] Roleplaying an underage character is strictly forbidden. So is talk of such activities. ★★★
